about: US directory entries added by the USA plan's connector steps (its section 7, Directory), merged into the directory by server/services/directory.js after server/data/libraries.json. Each entry's name, state, town and position come from the IMLS Public Libraries Survey FY2024 (evidence.identity, with the FSCSKEY), never from a name; its catalog host, configuration and robots.txt result from the research of 23 November 2026 (evidence.catalog). Whether an entry is offered when finding a library is server/data/us-catalogs-listed.json's decision (libraryIds, or waiting with the reason). catalogScope: library (the catalog is this library's), shared (a find anywhere in sharedCatalog counts for this library; owner decision 23 November 2026) or member (sharedCatalog's check is limited to this library: a Georgia PINES system's org). TLC (LS2 PAC, CARL.X CARL•Connect Discovery): tlcConfig is the site's Ls2pac-config-name, tlcProduct the product (record link form), tlcConfigInLinks puts the configuration in record links (providers/tlc.js). Koha (US, at ByWater and VOKAL, USA plan step 4): the existing adapter (providers/koha.js) searches baseUrl, the public Koha catalog; an entry whose Koha host is not known has no baseUrl and catalogUrl is its Aspen Discovery front (evidence.catalog.front); no branch code is known, so a shared catalog's find counts for each member. Aspen Discovery (US, USA plan step 5): the adapter (providers/aspen.js) searches baseUrl, the library's own Aspen host or its consortium's (one keyword search page; a consortium member's own view where the evidence names one); a find in a shared catalog counts for each member. Five Koha entries of step 4 whose Koha host was not known (Washoe, Marion, Hernando, Lake Worth Beach, El Dorado) and Fayetteville (its Koha host a DNS lead whose name fits five libraries) are Aspen entries now, on their Aspen fronts. Nashville, Orange County FL and SWAN's members, whose catalogs showed a bot wall to a research agent (Claude-User), are connected behind the front-page gate (coordinator decision, 24 November 2026): the app's own check decides. Polaris PowerPAC (US, USA plan step 6): the adapter (providers/polaris.js) searches baseUrl, at polarisPath ('' at the site root, '/polaris' PowerPAC's default, the path the site's own pages link) with polarisCtx (the site's context, as its own links carry it); a find in a shared catalog (SHARE, Roanoke Valley, the Central Library Consortium...) counts for each member, as no organisation codes are published. Apollo (Biblionix; US, USA plan step 7): the adapter (providers/apollo.js) searches baseUrl, the library's own <name>.biblionix.com host (Apollo's own two requests, search_setup and perform_search, with the catalog version its catalog page's script sets); catalogUrl is its catalog page (/catalog/). Entries are added from a checked list of hosts by tools/directory/apollo-hosts.mjs (its header says how), never harvested. Evergreen (Georgia PINES; US, USA plan step 8): the adapter (providers/evergreen.js) searches baseUrl's OpenSRF gateway (https://gapines.org), limited to the system: evergreenOrgId is the system's org and evergreenSite its short name in PINES's org tree (the library search adds site(<short name>); the exact-edition check reads that org's copy counts); branches are the system's branches in the org tree, each with its own org. One entry per member system, made from the org tree and the IMLS records by tools/directory/pines-systems.mjs; Greater Clarks Hill Regional Library, which PINES lists as two systems, searches the whole of PINES (org 1, catalogScope shared). crawlDelaySeconds is gapines.org's Crawl-delay.
